item.title: Everything Is Pass by Value — Memory Transfer in Go, Java, and Python
item.description: Calling a function with an object is often described as pass by reference, but in memory all three languages copy values. Java copies a reference value, Python binds a new name to the same object (call by sharing), and Go copies a struct header — escape analysis decides where the values live.
